card.name: Just before enzyme names
card.fires_on: Words right before a named enzyme or protein is spelled out, such as the YP in CYP2C8 or CYP2D6, and small linking words like of, to, as or the before enzyme targets. Also the species name after C. in C. difficile.

modes.label: Inside CYP names
modes.description: The YP part of CYP enzyme names, or the 'and' after CYP3A4, just before the next enzyme name.
modes.example: The metabolism of paclitaxel is catalyzed by cytochrome P450 isoenzymes C<<YP>>2C8 and CYP3A

modes.label: Linking word before an enzyme
modes.description: A small word such as of, to, as or inhibit that leads into an enzyme or pathway name.
modes.example: Lovastatin, like other inhibitors<< of>> HMG-CoA reductase,

modes.label: Species after abbreviated genus
modes.description: The word difficile after C. in a toxin or assay phrase.
modes.example: stool assay for C.<< difficile>> toxin may be helpful diagnostically.
